relationships.subject: chronic low back pain
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1sRII (23.2 vs. 15.5 ng/ml, p < 0.001) and hepatocyte growth factor (HGF)-1 (169 vs. 105 pg/ml, p < 0.01) concentrations were significantly higher among patients.

key_findings: Serum IL-1sRII and HGF were higher in CLBP patients with Modic changes than in controls.
Many inflammatory and angiogenic markers including VEGF-C, VEGF-D and TNF-alpha were lower in patients than controls, irrespective of MC type or size.
